key_findings: NTG reduced Znhit1 in the mouse TNC; AAV Znhit1 overexpression relieved hyperalgesia and lowered CGRP, c-Fos, IL-6, IL-1β, TNF-α, COX-2 and iNOS.
Znhit1 suppressed NLRP3/ASC/cleaved caspase-1 in TNC and LPS-treated BV2 cells; the NLRP3 inhibitor MCC950 reversed Znhit1-silencing effects.
